items.quote: Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you;
items.claim: Moses tells God he expects to go to the Israelites and say that the God of their fathers has sent him.

items.quote: and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
items.claim: Moses expects the Israelites to ask for God's name, and he asks God what he should tell them.

items.quote: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM:
items.claim: God answers Moses by calling himself "I AM THAT I AM".

items.quote: Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
items.claim: God tells Moses to say to the Israelites that "I AM" has sent him.
